title: Charles University Doctoral Study Income (full-time doctoral students)
program_type: Institutional guaranteed doctoral study income (stipend or salary) for full-time doctoral students
duration: Full-time doctoral students receive doctoral study income during the standard length of their studies (4 years); other schemes run for the academic year or the period specified in the awarding body's rules
description: Charles University guarantees every full-time doctoral student a doctoral study income of at least 1.2 times the Czech minimum wage for the standard length of the doctorate (four years). title: International Visegrad Fund Fellowships and Scholarships (V4 mobility)
program_type: Regional research and study mobility fellowship programme (Visegrad Fund)
duration: Max 2 semesters at master’s or post-Master’s (doctoral, postdoc) degree levels.
description: The International Visegrad Fund runs regional mobility programmes for Czechia, Hungary, Poland, Slovakia and Ukraine. The Visegrad Fellowship Program funds individual short-term in-person stays of 2 to 10 weeks for full-time doctoral students and PhD holders to conduct a research project, give lectures or seminars, or study archival material at an institution in a V4 country other than their country of citizenship and residence; it pays a lump-sum scholarship of EUR 500 per week in two instalments (80% and 20%). official_source: International Visegrad Fund (host institution: Masaryk University, Brno)

title: Erasmus Mundus Joint Master Degrees — Czech Universities
program_type: EU consortium master's degree scholarship (joint degree across 3+ countries)
duration: 1 to 2 academic years (60, 90 or 120 ECTS credits). Typically includes periods of study, research, traineeship, thesis preparation and defence.
description: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters are prestigious international master's programmes jointly designed and delivered by a group of higher education institutions involving at least 3 institutions from at least 3 different countries, plus academic and non-academic partners. Students apply directly to the institution running the programme, and full scholarships are available for the best students, covering participation costs and contributing to travel, visa and a living allowance. title: Erasmus Mundus Joint Master Degrees — Portuguese Universities
duration: 1 to 2 academic years (60, 90 or 120 ECTS credits). Programmes typically include periods of study, research, traineeship, thesis preparation and defence.
description: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters are prestigious international master's programmes jointly designed and delivered by at least three higher education institutions in at least three countries, with additional academic and non-academic partners. Students apply directly to the institution running the programme, and the best-ranked applicants worldwide can receive full scholarships that cover participation costs and contribute to travel, visa and a living allowance. Degrees run 1-2 academic years (60, 90 or 120 ECTS) and yield either a joint degree or at least two national degrees.
